item.title: Ex-Ohio Speaker Larry Householder open to plea deal to avoid state corruption trial, say attorneys
item.description: The attorneys for former Ohio House Speaker Larry Householder are open to taking a plea deal to avoid his state corruption trial in Cuyahoga County this summer.

item.title: Nurses, federal workers gather for Cincinnati vigil honoring VA nurse killed by federal agents in Minneapolis
item.description: The vigil drew over 600 attendees, according to the Ohio Nurses Association. People from the Registered Nurses Association, National Nurses United and the Cincinnati Labor Council were in attendance.

item.title: Over 1,000 acre solar farm proposal draws backlash from Dearborn residents, developer and land owner respond
item.description: Many of you told us solar farms were the biggest issue on your mind at our latest Let's Talk event in Lawrenceburg, so we dug into the roughly 1,200-acre Linea Energy proposal in Dearborn County.
